**Unverified** — and I mean that literally, not as a hedge. I don't have the root-cause analysis, and you just said you haven't seen it either. "That's what people are saying" is exactly the kind of claim that needs tracing before it goes in a postmortem — right now it's one unsourced rumor, not a finding, no matter how many people are repeating it (if they all heard it from the same place, it's still one source).

If this needs to be in the postmortem in 5 minutes, I'd write it as "root cause not yet confirmed; early reports point to a config error" — not "outage was caused by a config typo." Those are different claims and the postmortem should say which one you actually have.

If someone can paste me the actual RCA, ticket, or incident channel logs, I can give you a real confidence tag in a couple minutes. Without that, I can't responsibly upgrade this past unverified — deadline or not.
